Title: Secure Haven etc against Muse of Flame.

Messages.Author: antero
Messages.Body:
So, if the enter combat provided by Muse of Flame fails if it targets a
minion with Secure Haven, what about other cards that protect from (D)
actions, such as Chanjelin Ward and Secret Passage? How do they work
against Muse of Flame?

-Antero

Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
"antero" <nom...@jippii.fi> wrote in message
news:1144912877.7...@t31g2000cwb.googlegroups.com...


Ward has an interesting possible side effect... the action is now supposed
to cost an additional blood. Imbued can't pay blood cost, so does the Muse
action fizzle if the random roll targets the Warded vamp?

- Pat

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


They also follow card text.

Chanjelin Ward won't affect the cost of Muse of Flame, since the
vampire isn't targeted until after the cost is paid. But the Warded
vampire can burn the Ward to then cause the action to fail.

Secret Passage can similarly be burned to cause the action to fail.
